hypotheses.P1_family_basis_beats_global_at32: The family-bank weight basis exceeds the leave-one-pair-out global-bank basis by at least 0.05 native-patch fidelity at rank 32 on both corpora.
hypotheses.P2_family_basis_beats_best_wrong_at32: The family-bank basis exceeds the best wrong-family-bank basis by at least 0.05 native-patch fidelity at rank 32 on both corpora.
hypotheses.P3_family_rank64_nearly_recovers_native_: The family weight rank-64 basis reaches at least 0.90 downstream fidelity to the exact native patch on both corpora.
hypotheses.P4_family_rank64_preserves_full_mlp_rele: Family weight rank 64 is within 0.05 full-MLP fidelity of the exact native patch on both corpora.
hypotheses.P5_family_and_global_axes_are_distinct: Median mean canonical cosine between family and global top-32 weight bases is at most 0.75 on both corpora.
hypotheses.P6_basis_specificity_transfers_ood: The family-versus-best-wrong rank-32 advantage is positive on TinyStories.
